economics_basis: Studio formula: net = price/1.18; contribution = net - landed - (0.02*price + 1.2) - 0.08*net; margin = contribution/net = 89.64 - 118*(landed+1.2)/price (%); fx 3.3; before CAC. price_ils is the card price when it exists, otherwise my proposal by Israeli value (h.10, not approved). Pairs and sets are priced as sold (P1), and landed is multiplied by the quantity (conservative). Prints are sold unframed by the supplier: their margin is BEFORE local framing (PR1). loses_at_slot_price=true marks 13 picks (12 products) that lose money at the pack's slot median (slot_price_ils) and enter only at the higher proposed price_ils; they need the owner's price approval, otherwise they drop (then 45 accessory slots keep a pick instead of 52, and 5 slots have 3 instead of 6).
